core_obligations: Construct explicit lifted root vectors and central generators.
Prove image independence and graded spanning with the positive current presentation.
Conclude injectivity of the full presented algebra.
difficulty_reason: The author builds explicit root generators and central terms for the omega-fixed presentation, proves linear independence of their images, and then uses a graded degeneration and the positive current-algebra presentation to establish spanning. Both the central extension and the infinite family of root/current relations are essential to injectivity. This is a structural PBW argument for a toroidal fixed-point algebra beyond ordinary qualifying-exam Lie algebra exercises.
